headline: Gadgets, apps and small surprises this week
body: I've been making little things that each do one job well. Reach, my desk clock, now has a live LED preview, and The Morning Paper is up on Projects. The guestbook is open if you want to say hi.
items: Reach: a desk clock with a live LED preview
The Morning Paper: an e-ink front page each morning
Snippy: a Chrome extension with a rewritten privacy policy
Guestbook open: leave a note and say hi
